crew.original_title: Tinker Bell and the Legend of the NeverBeast
crew.overview: An ancient myth of a massive creature sparks the curiosity of Tinker Bell and her good friend Fawn, an animal fairy who’s not afraid to break the rules to help an animal in need. But this creature is not welcome in Pixie Hollow — and the scout fairies are determined to capture the mysterious beast, who they fear will destroy their home. Fawn must convince her fairy friends to risk everything to rescue the NeverBeast.
crew.title: Tinker Bell and the Legend of the NeverBeast

crew.original_title: The Lion King II: Simba's Pride
crew.overview: The circle of life continues for Simba, now fully grown and in his rightful place as the king of Pride Rock. Simba and Nala have given birth to a daughter, Kiara who's as rebellious as her father was. But Kiara drives her parents to distraction when she catches the eye of Kovu, the son of the evil lioness, Zira. Will Kovu steal Kiara's heart?
crew.title: The Lion King II: Simba's Pride

details.biography: Mark McCorkle (born August 1961) is an American screenwriter, television writer and television producer. He is the co-creator of the Disney Channel animated series, Kim Possible, alongside Bob Schooley, who frequently works with McCorkle.
details.name: Mark McCorkle
